messages:
nina_cs: Flagging an incident impacting search relevance for ~10 onboarding tenants. Getting noisy NPS feedback. Need a short public note + targeted outreach.
sam_sre: Root cause identified: recent index compaction combined with a memory regression in the indexer process. Some shards served stale segments after failover.
li_dev: We've pushed a hotfix to the indexer (v2.1.3) that prevents compaction from overlapping with in-flight reindexes. Rolling patch now; reindex pipeline restarted.
kevin_csm: Can we offer affected customers an explicit remediation ETA and compensation? I'd like to be able to tell them exact timings during outreach.
nina_cs: Proposing tiered compensation: priority (top 3) -> 20% credit + dedicated troubleshooting session; others -> 10% credit + invite to live office hours. Thoughts?
sam_sre: Technical ETA: first successful reindexes in ~30-45m for small tenants; full catch-up for the last tenants ~5-6 hours depending on index size. We'll post per-tenant ETA in this thread as they complete.
ops-bot: Patch rollout 17686 started. 3/10 tenant reindexes completed. See: https://status.redwood.io/incidents/17686
li_dev: Confirmed no data integrity issues; this is a quality/regression incident only.
kevin_csm: I'll draft two outreach templates: 1) priority account note (personalized), 2) bulk impacted tenants. Will include opt-in link for priority reindex: https://forms.redwood/priority-reindex-17686
nina_cs: Good — add a short FAQ (what happened, what we did, what we're doing, compensation) and include the status page link. Legal sign-off requested ASAP.
sam_sre: We'll run verification checks post-reindex: relevance delta, recall checks, and sample queries provided by CSMs. Please collect examples.
kevin_csm: I'll ask impacted CSMs to gather 2-3 failing queries per tenant and paste in this thread.
li_dev: Monitoring dashboard: https://internal.redwood/monitoring/indexer/17686 - adding alerts for regressions.
ops-bot: Office hours scheduled by nina_cs for tomorrow 09:00 AM PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/office-17686
nina_cs: Final tasks: kevin -> outreach + collect query examples; sam/li -> hourly tech updates and per-tenant ETA; me -> publish public note once legal okays. We'll proactively apply credits; customers don't need to request. This thread is SSoT. :white_check_mark:
kevin_csm: Starting outreach now. Will tag customers in their threads and track replies in CSM tracker.
li_dev: Rolling updates every 30m until full recovery.
ops-bot: Patch rollout 17686: 6/10 tenant reindexes completed as of 1768622922.
